rules: choose among already-valid HRC zero-run baselines using DSC code 110 only when one alternative is a unique strict improvement
never post-hoc reparent individual HRC nodes from code 110
class-0 records participate in the model hierarchy only when subtype is zero

class0_census.policy: class-0/nonzero signatures are internal/helper payload records, not transform/null model nodes

environment_srt_census.fix: parse the first nine numeric values following SRT up to the semicolon; MPRFLG is optional trailing syntax

class4_srt_census.overlapping_slot_anchor_regression: a zero-width material-slot signature scan recovers serialized SRTs that a consuming regex can skip when signatures overlap inside the final float

texture_source_census.policy: preserve missing picture paths as source-completeness warnings; do not invent or cross-bind picture bytes

class1_patch_census.common_envelope: header + XYZ control lattice + closure/tension/step/curve + approximation fields + u16 recursion + N tagged-point u16 flags + zero u16 tag terminator + nine-float local SRT
class1_patch_census.type3_policy: open code-3 roots are evaluated as tensor-product uniform cubic B-splines using source U/V Step; closed code-3 remains unsupported because the corpus has no such example
class1_patch_census.type2_policy: retain control-cage approximation until Cardinal interpolation and closed-boundary semantics are independently validated

reference_scenes.qualification_role: class-0 helper filtering and root-SRT alternate-line-form validation
zero-residual hierarchy plus class-1 type-3 open B-spline ROOT validation

orchestration_qualification.checkpoint_behavior: batch_reconstruction.json is written after each processed scene, including failures

notes: Every DSC received structural/source preflight and every declared root participated in hierarchy/SRT census work; full glTF reconstruction was exercised on exact references, a 22-scene cross-family set, and additional blocker-focused movie scenes.
Blender was unavailable in the qualification sandbox, so scene.blend finishing remains a local-user release check.
Do not cross-bind the 100 ISDF_outro missing root HRC references to similarly named assets from other source groups/revisions.
Class-1 type 2 remains an explicitly documented control-cage approximation pending exact Cardinal/closure validation.
